title: Avery and Tillman at Tyler's Beer Garden and solos then and now
summary: Allen recalls Joe Avery and Wilbur Tillman's band playing lead right through; De De says short solos are the written norm today.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
